name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Punjab)
benefit:
- Pension is Rs. 300/- per month (age 18-79 year)
- Pension is Rs. 500/- per month (age 80 and above year)
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
   1. The applicant should be a person with a disability.
   1. The percentage of the disability should be 80% or more.
   1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 80 years.
